18.headline: Edwards scores 43 as Stingrays rally past Bears in double overtime
18.dek: Stony Brook erased a 19-point deficit for its sixth straight win, and the loss left Waltham, Manhattan and Rochester tied for first at 12-6.

games.text: Anthony Edwards scored 43 points on 15-of-22 shooting and Stony Brook beat Waltham 143-129 in double overtime for its sixth straight win. The Bears led by 19 and by 12 after three quarters, then scored 12 points in the fourth. Stony Brook won the second overtime 16-2. Tyler Herro added 25 points, and LeBron James led Waltham with 26.

Tyrese Maxey scored 40 points and Luka Dončić had 20 points, 16 rebounds and 12 assists as Queens beat Durham 116-109 in overtime. The Destroyers led by 16 before Queens won the third quarter 32-19. Donovan Mitchell had 36 points and 13 rebounds for Durham, which played without Jalen Johnson and Tyrese Haliburton and lost its third straight.

Jayson Tatum had 20 points, 10 rebounds and six assists, and Cambridge edged Gooning 101-100 in a game with 18 lead changes. The teams were tied at 70 after three quarters. Victor Wembanyama added 17 points and 14 rebounds for the Platypuses, who have won three straight. Evan Mobley had 13 points, 16 rebounds and 11 assists for the Gooners, who fell to 3-15.

Franz Wagner scored 33 points and Jabari Smith Jr. added 31 on 11-of-15 shooting as Toronto beat Rochester 128-112. The Jays led 31-13 after one quarter, never trailed and were ahead by as many as 35. Trey Murphy III scored 27 for the Dragons, who were missing Fred VanVleet and Moses Moody and lost their second straight.

Giannis Antetokounmpo had 24 points, 18 rebounds and seven assists on 8-of-10 shooting, and Manhattan beat Ithaca 119-100 to pull even with Waltham and Rochester at the top of the standings. The Elephants led 38-22 after the first quarter and by as many as 24. Kawhi Leonard scored 31 for the Thunder.
